name: When should I hire a handyman instead of a specialized contractor?
description: Hire a handyman for small, varied tasks like minor repairs or installations; choose a specialized contractor for large-scale projects requiring specific license

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a handyman instead of a specialized contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should hire a handyman for smaller, varied tasks that don't require the specific licensing or extensive scope of a specialized contractor. For example, a handyman can fix a leaky faucet, hang shelves, repair drywall, or paint a room. A specialized contractor, like a plumber or electrician, is better suited for large-scale installations, major repairs, or projects requiring specific permits and in-depth expertise, such as rewiring a house or installing a new water heater.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a handyman for small, varied tasks like minor repairs or installations; choose a specialized contractor for large-scale projects requiring specific licenses or permits.
